title: 第960章 突破地煞境第959章 碾压轰杀
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
陈丹求看傻了，完全看傻了眼！
整个人都不知道该说些什么了。
黄恒，一位地源中期的鬼兽族修士，实力极其强大，天赋也极其妖孽，然而这样的存在，在李浪的面前，却是扛不住一招！
被一招给瞬间秒杀了！
没错，李浪从出场出手，再到杀死黄恒，几乎掌握着所有的战斗节奏。
最后一招黄金狮火剑印斩出，更是完全粉碎击溃掉了黄恒的防御，直接将其给斩杀掉。
太猛了！
这就是李浪的真正实力么？
陈丹求傻眼，论及战斗，李浪更是狂野凶猛，手段一点都不会心慈手软。
杀死了黄恒，对于李浪而言，都不算什么难事。
取过黄恒的地脉鬼兽丹，李浪来到了陈丹求的面前，将这枚地脉鬼兽丹直接赠给了陈丹求。
“这我不能收，这太贵重了！”
陈丹求赶忙摆手。
这可是一颗地源境的地脉鬼兽丹啊，何等珍贵之物？
不过，李浪却是笑了笑，直接将这枚地脉鬼兽丹抛掷给了陈丹求。
下一刻，屈指一叩，鬼神空饰闪烁流光，密密麻麻的地脉鬼兽丹，浮现在了李浪的周身，看的陈丹求一时间哑然，忍不住倒吸冷气。
这也……太多了吧？
不过，陈丹求很快就想起了先前李浪那贡献点狂飙的一幕，看来李浪是真的屠杀了这些修士！
收获了这么多的鬼兽丹！
既然如此，陈丹求也就没有再客气了，一颗地脉鬼兽丹，对他而言，还是十分重要的，至少能帮助他快速提升修为。

到了地纹境之后，境界想要提升，炼化鬼兽族的鬼兽丹，乃是一个极快的方式！
嗡——
不过，就在陈丹求刚收起鬼兽丹的时候，便猛地被吓一跳。
因为，一道曼妙的身影，不知道什么时候出现在了李浪的身后，而李浪一副根本不知晓的模样。
“阿浪！
小心！”
陈丹求目光一缩，因为他一眼就看出了，这出现在李浪身后的女人，她不是人！
绝对不是人！
而是鬼兽族修士！
李浪扭头看了一眼孔渔，孔渔亦是满脸苦笑无奈的摊了摊手。
“主人，我可能吓到他了。”
孔渔开口。
主……主人？
陈丹求头皮顿时一麻，原本心中提起的警惕，瞬间崩溃消失。
啥啊这是……
他难以置信的看向了李浪，这异族女人……成了李浪的奴隶？
李浪这段时间在黑魔原中，到底都干了些什么事啊？
陈丹求完全无法想象出李浪到底在黑魔原中做了哪些事情，整个人都是发麻的。
李浪笑了笑，倒是没有太在意，笑着给陈丹求解释了孔渔的情况。
content_en:
Chen Danqiu was dumbfounded, completely dumbfounded!
Everyone didn't know what to say.
Huang Heng, a ghost beast monk in the middle stage of Earth Origin, was extremely powerful and extremely talented. However, such a being couldn't withstand a move in front of Li Lang!
He was instantly killed by one move!
That's right, Li Lang almost controlled all the rhythm of the battle from the moment he came out and took action to killing Huang Heng.
The last move was the Golden Lion Fire Sword Seal, which completely shattered Huang Heng's defense and killed him directly.
So fierce!
Is this Li Lang's true strength?
Chen Danqiu was dumbfounded. When it came to fighting, Li Lang was even more wild and ferocious, and his methods were not merciful at all.
Killing Huang Heng was not a difficult task for Li Lang.
After taking Huang Heng's Earth Line Ghost Beast Pill, Li Lang came to Chen Danqiu and gave the Earth Line Ghost Beast Pill directly to Chen Danqiu.
"I can't accept this, it's too expensive!"
Chen Danqiu waved his hand quickly.
This is an Earth Origin Realm Earth Vein Ghost Beast Pill. How precious is it?
However, Li Lang smiled and threw the Earth Vein Ghost Beast Pill directly to Chen Danqiu.
The next moment, with a tap of his finger, the ghost and god ornaments flickered, and the dense earth vein ghost and beast pills appeared all over Li Lang. Chen Danqiu was speechless for a moment and couldn't help but gasp.
Is this... too much?
However, Chen Danqiu quickly remembered the previous scene where Li Lang's contribution points were soaring. It seemed that Li Lang had really massacred these monks!
I harvested so many ghost beast pills!
In this case, Chen Danqiu was no longer polite. An Earth Vein Ghost Beast Pill was still very important to him. It could at least help him improve his cultivation quickly.
After reaching the Earth Pattern Realm, if you want to improve your realm, refining the Ghost Beast Clan's Ghost Beast Pill is an extremely fast way!
Buzz——
However, just when Chen Danqiu put away the Ghost Beast Pill, he was suddenly startled.
Because, a graceful figure appeared behind Li Lang at some point, and Li Lang looked like he didn't know it at all.
"Alang!
Be careful! "
Chen Danqiu's eyes shrank, because he could tell at a glance that the woman who appeared behind Li Lang was not a human!
Definitely not a human being!
But a monk from the Ghost Beast Clan!
Li Lang turned his head and glanced at Kong Yu, who also spread his hands helplessly with a wry smile on his face.
"Master, I may have scared him."
Kong Yu spoke.
Lord...master?
Chen Danqiu's scalp suddenly felt numb, and the vigilance in his heart suddenly collapsed and disappeared.
What is this...
He looked at Li Lang in disbelief. This foreign woman... became Li Lang's slave?
What did Li Lang do in the Black Demon Field during this time?
Chen Danqiu couldn't imagine what Li Lang had done in the Black Demon Field, and his whole body was numb.
Li Lang smiled, but didn't pay much attention. He smiled and explained Kong Yu's situation to Chen Danqiu.
